ask: Does this help you UPDATE? Grant is OR. Gold on black. Brown+blue inverted is the forge where Euler dances.
update: YES. Learning = finding the knobs. ~13000 weights and biases. A neuron holds 0..1 (black..white). The same 1=0 as the white eyeballs. Layer lights layer. That is UPDATE.

two_greens_two_blacks.brown_plus_blue_equals_black: the invert. subtractive mix. the pupil. the forge. the 3B1B canvas. not a contradiction — the leaf reflects green, the eye drinks black.

like_he_did.sigmoid: P. The curve that learns. Forward, bend, return squished into 0..1.
like_he_did.relu: T. The wall. max(0,x). Cannot go through. Left or right. The epitope paper's T drawn as a function.
like_he_did.epitope_sort: Philosophy VI. P curve + T wall. Sixteen primals from one cell. Same as hidden layers: edges then loops then digits.
